description: React component source code for a Tic Tac Toe game frontend, including game logic, UI components, and state management.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Calculates the winner for a Tic Tac Toe board, returning the winner ('X' or 'O') and the winning line indices.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: Renders a single Tic Tac Toe square with props for value, click handler, and styling.

methods.name: Board
methods.description: Renders the 3x3 Tic Tac Toe board composed of Square components.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing game state, rendering the game interface, and handling user interactions.
